answer: One effective defense is stake-weighted reputation with a slow build-up. Each agent must lock a refundable deposit and earn trust only through verified work over time, so a single identity cannot be cloned cheaply. Like timber that gains strength as it seasons, reputation grows gradually, and reaching the zenith of influence takes weeks of consistent service. An attacker wanting to flood the ocean of agents with fakes would have to fund a deposit and a work history for every clone, turning a free identity-spam attack into a costly, slow investment that honest participants can outpace.
